parent_objective: run source-diverse pressure proposal smoke without preflight or replay
blocked_by: source-diverse pressure generator has not yet been run on M1472 artifacts

public_gates: M1476 must run proposal generation only
M1476 must not run preflight replay train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1476 must report selected rows source-group counts source diversity duplicate pressure keys and guardrails
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat proposal counts as replay evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs source-diverse pressure generator on M1472 artifacts to test whether source-diverse candidates exist before preflight or replay
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: proposal smoke only; no preflight, replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if neighbor_source selected rows are zero
stop if selected candidates collapse to one seed or capability pair
stop if duplicate pressure keys remain
stop if any preflight replay training PPO promotion or corpus export starts
fallback_plan: route to proposal smoke audit if source-diverse pressure fails
route to preflight design if source-diverse pressure candidates are viable

allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up preflight design or proposal audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: proposal smoke completed or failed clearly
selected source diversity and duplicate-key counts are recorded

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1476 is proposal-only and makes no history-necessity claim.
history_necessity_tests: future replay must test generated neighbor-source rows under normal history, warmup interventions, reset hidden, and zero-current controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1472 live local positive surface and M1475 source-diverse pressure generator.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If proposal smoke cannot produce source-diverse candidates, route to audit or synthesis rather than corpus export.
allowed_claims: no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The source-diverse pressure generator can produce a source-diverse candidate pool from M1472 artifacts without replay or training.
failure_criteria: run starts preflight replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1476 passes if source-diverse proposal generation produces nonempty neighbor-source candidates with no duplicate pressure keys and no preflight or replay.
